page.content:
The Double-Tailed Spider was a type of spider-like species native to Yautja Prime. An individual of the species was eaten and killed by an Alien Chameleon shortly after it ate a shelled insect.

page.overview:
What is Double-Tailed Spider?

The Double-Tailed Spider was a type of spider-like species native to Yautja Prime. An individual of the species was eaten and killed by an Alien Chameleon shortly after it ate a shelled insect.
